name: Enkeltbillet
source:
The heroine, Okazawa Midori, is a second year student in junior college. In order to have a graduation trip with her friend, Togawa Saki, Midori has been working part-time since spring. It's going to be a 10-day cruising tour around Northern Europe. Her parents are worried because this will be her first time traveling abroad, but they give the permission as long as she can find a job.

On the day of the trip, Midori stepped onto a plane for the very first time. She feels nervous because everything is a new experience for her, and so the tour group depart from Narita towards Avesta Airport in Sweden. Unfortunately, Midori runs into numerous trials and troubles in Northern Europe. She can't speak English despite having knowledge of the language.

Things get worse when Midori gets separated from Saki, ends up lost in the airport, AND gets robbed on top of that. She submits an application to make a new passport, but since it's going to take a while, she will be staying in a hotel in the meantime.

In an unfamiliar land, Midori meets people she can't have a proper conversation with… and the experience gradually changes her.

[Taken from [URL=http://otome-jikan.net/2013/10/enkeltbillet-a-journey-overseas/]Otome Jikan[/URL].]
translation:
女主角冈泽绿是短期大学二年级的学生。为了和朋友远川沙希一起毕业旅行，绿从春天开始就开始打工。这将是一次为期10天的北欧巡游之旅。她的父母很担心，因为这是她第一次出国旅行，但只要她能找到工作，他们就同意了。

旅行当天，绿第一次踏上飞机。她感到紧张，因为一切对她来说都是新的体验，于是旅行团从成田出发前往瑞典阿维斯塔机场。不幸的是，Midori在北欧遇到了无数的考验和麻烦。尽管她懂英语，但她不会说英语。

当Midori与Saki失散，最终在机场迷路，并且还遭到抢劫时，事情变得更糟。她提交了制作新护照的申请，但由于需要一段时间，因此她在此期间将住在酒店。

在陌生的土地上，绿遇到了一些她无法正常交谈的人……这段经历逐渐改变了她。

[摘自[URL=http://otome-jikan.net/2013/10/enkeltbillet-a-journey-overseas/]乙女事件[/URL].]
